question: Are the eight original deposited D6/D30 ATAC tracks correctly joined, locally readable and compatible with mm10 chromosome lengths, and which scale/coordinate uncertainties remain?
decision: Qualify source/header/readability inputs and precise unresolved semantics before proposing a biological S3 comparison for coordinator review; perform no between-track signal comparison.
strongest_rival: Compatible BigWig structure and chromosome dictionaries may be mistaken for established signal normalization, original region identity or biological independence. Stored summaries cannot identify the full processing transform.
discriminator: Verify frozen source/acquisition joins, exact chromosome lengths against UCSC mm10, supported-reader headers and one prespecified bounded query. Reuse coordinator original-coordinate coverage rather than repeat broad source scans.
exposure_record: Published accessibility conclusions, S1M and all S2/S4/S4B results were already viewed. Original BigWigs were downloaded and hashed before this specification, but no research-track header/signal query was made. The supported reader was tested on a pinned upstream toy fixture only. Coordinator supplied bounded original-coordinate and paper-method findings; the technical chat has not repeated those scans. No freeze erases prior exposure.
biological_unit: Eight deposited ATAC libraries, two per D6/D30 history/control group. Source-reported biological replication and pooled preparations remain positive evidence; exact membership, overlap and cross-assay mapping are unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: The same original GSE92967 source underlies the published claim. Chromosomes, intervals and stored summary fields are file metadata/features, not biological replicates. No matching is inferred from R1/R2 labels.
population_and_selection: Exactly GSM2441001-GSM2441008 and their saved GEO/S1M source records; D180, raw reads, other studies and new workbook scans excluded. All track chromosomes retained in metadata outputs.
contrast: No biological contrast. Check accession/file identity, dictionary and header consistency; the fixed chr1:10000000-10000100 query only tests readability and missingness shape.
endpoint: File identities, exact bytes and bound hashes, chromosome names/lengths, stored header summaries/zoom metadata and bounded-query finite/missing counts; unresolved signal scale and region definition are explicit.
methods: Windows standard-library wrapper verifies SOFT/crosswalk/acquisition joins and invokes a frozen WSL reader with Python 3.13.18, pybbi 0.4.2 and NumPy 2.5.5. Reader obtains BigWig type, chromosome dictionary, stored header and zoom levels and one fixed 100-base chr1 query with missing=NaN; it retains only query length and finite/missing counts. Compare every chromosome with the canonical mm10 dictionary and retain missing/mismatched/extra names. No signal difference, transformed rank, retained-region classification or new biological run. Independent stdlib verification checks identity, dictionary/summary consistency and query boundaries.
missingness_and_exclusions: All eight tracks and all stored chromosomes retained. Missing/incompatible chromosomes are recorded rather than relabelled. An unqueryable chr1 is flagged; missing signal is NaN, never silently zero-imputed. No source is reassigned or excluded after seeing header values.
multiplicity: No inferential tests, gene/region screening or population prevalence. Metadata counts do not provide biological replication.
precision_basis: Metadata qualification has no biological effect margin, sampling precision or power calculation. A finite 100-base smoke query does not independently decode every data block.
interpretation_limit: Header compatibility cannot establish deposited normalization, fragment dispersion, original memory-domain coordinates or causal/functional memory. The source paper Z-score description alone is insufficient to label the .bw scale. If between-track scale stays unresolved, preserve the plan boundary of within-track visualization only until a separately reviewed method exists.
stop_rule: Require frozen committed contract/code and matching input hashes. Fail on source identity/hash mismatch, unsupported runtime, malformed reader output or failed independent verification. Record genome compatibility failures explicitly. Preserve failed real runs. Return a concrete S3 method/estimand for review before any biological numerical comparison; no restricted broad source extraction or safeguard changes.
amendment_reason: New authorized metadata-only S3 qualification after reviewed and committed S4B; preserved source acquisition and supported runtime preparation precede the first research-track header query.
